body:
Continues ANI-03 on the existing dialogue/elemental-performance branch, stacked on draft PR #122. This development PR preserves Story receipts and all human/release gates as false. No merge or release authorization.

Native opposing projectiles now resolve automatically after fixed-tick movement and before fighter damage. Existing rectangle shapes are swept in relative motion, with time-of-impact and stable owner/shot ordering. Explicit per-move aura integrity, team exclusion, equal cancellation, breakthrough, residual damage and immediate cancellation cleanup replace callback-order-dependent projectile contact. Existing aura clashes, movement archetypes, terrain policy and combat frame/damage values remain intact outside the authorized interception rules. Original pooled elemental effects and audio communicate collision and weakening with Full/Balanced/Reduced support.

The ordinary two-player Kaia/Juno input run earned aura without seeding: quick and medium shots canceled; Juno's full shot survived4vs1 as3vs0 and subsequently dealt6.6577824 damage. A separate active-CPU attempt observed no projectile clash and remains excluded from clash acceptance. Declared fixtures cover four-shot exhaustion, shielding/invulnerability, near-fighter priority, same-team exclusion, fast sweeps and deterministic order. Nine affected suites pass;18 medium/full native emitter comparisons preserve exact trajectories and lifetimes. Exit resource diagnostics remain in logs.

Also preserves the finished-clip pelvis/support recovery correction across36fighter/body/facing cases, explicit high-aura authored-link inheritance and Kaia's genuine~81–83aura jab1→jab2→upTilt observations. No full catalog or aerial-route certification. The13earned-node Story continuation and existing145-node/1025cue authority remain preserved.

Manual review: `tools/v1_closure/play_projectile_review.command` (activeCPU), `--local` (twohuman inputs), `--male` (existingmale models), separateuserprofile. Concise review/evidence: `artifacts/v1_closure/spectral_feedback/continuous_1020/PROJECTILE_PLAYABLE_REVIEW.md`. Core runtime validated atcf46897045611a46b5c4d9b6c55a83f276e37c4d; individual public traces retain their own source IDs. No new native movie or platform export.

Physical floor/outer-reach/contact integration, complete authored choreography, broader ordinary projectile matchups, owner aesthetic/mix/game-feel approval, ANI-04 acting/OVA and ANI-05 devices/platform/release acceptance remain unfinished. Existing recordings and33worktrees preserved.
title: V1 development: dialogue, full-roster combat feedback and Story continuation
